Task: stock report shows incorrect quantities after corrections. Root cause: in totals.py apply(), the `destination = bucket(receipt)` line was outside the per-contribution loop, so all contributions in a change were aggregated under the last receipt's depot/item bucket, misattributing quantities when a correction changed depot/item. Fix: move `destination = bucket(receipt)` inside the `for receipt, units in contributions(change)` loop so each contribution (old subtraction, new addition) targets its own receipt's bucket. Edit accepted (sequence 12), candidate 3dce94985b28ebdae35c0bbf6be4d7db639503dc8319a32ffbe8727431e602b1. check public passed (CHK-0014). Submitting.
